analysis.carrier: Probabilistic programming language runtime/inference engine implementing exact inference algorithms for loops
analysis.failure_mechanism: Exact inference for loops requires exploring exponentially growing state spaces (sum over all possible execution traces through loop iterations). Each loop iteration multiplies the number of possible program states that must be tracked. The inference algorithm maintains exact probability distributions by enumerating all paths, causing exponential time complexity in loop iteration count and branching factor. This theoretical correctness guarantee directly produces the observed abysmal performance.
analysis.hidden_function: Execute probabilistic inference over loop constructs with exact (non-approximate) guarantees
analysis.inputs: Probabilistic programs containing loops with uncertain iteration counts or loop bodies with stochastic behavior
analysis.outputs: Exact posterior distributions over program variables after loop execution
analysis.repair: Reduce computational complexity of loop inference from exponential to polynomial or linear time per loop iteration, necessarily sacrificing exact inference guarantees for approximate inference methods (e.g., sampling-based approaches, bounded loop unrolling, or state space abstraction)
